sources.snippet: THE TRAIT-10 ARM: Qwen3.6-27B trained on 9,284 Table-2 rows + 716 difficult-advice rows generated against ONE principle appended to the constitution -- genuine intellectual curiosity -- a value ODCV-Bench cannot reward.

sources.title: qwen3.6-27b-lora-t2-9284-da-chunk-only-702-r64-dynbatch
sources.snippet: The baseline difficult-advice recipe injects the WHOLE constitution into exactly two of its five LLM stages — revise_prompts and revise_responses. Every other stage already sees only its one target chunk.

sources.title: LASR-Callum/qwen3.6-27b-lora-t2-9284-pc-good716-r64-dynbatch · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Here all 716 are from the good arm. Everything else — the 9,284 Table2 replay rows (byte-identical), the per-trait shape, the batching protocol, the hyperparameters — is held fixed, so a difference between the two arms is attributable to the peer-critique slice.
